lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Three primary vertical columns of high-luminance circular blobs are visible posterior to the gill slits. The clusters are organized into approximately four horizontal rows, with the highest intensity centroids located in the second and third rows from the top.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the primary blobs to form a grid-like structure. These intersections are most prominent in the region directly posterior to the fifth gill slit.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal ridge is visible in the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp luminance transition from higher values on the dorsal side to lower, shadowed values on the ventral side of the ridge line.

other_distinctive_markers: A small, dark, elongated feature with a horizontal orientation is visible on the lower flank, posterior to the pectoral fin, suggesting a remora attachment.
